The plate looks like a square dinner plate of roughly 26 cm.

The scrambled eggs cover about 10×9 cm and look about 2–3 cm thick. That is roughly 1/2 cup, or about 2 eggs' worth, so around 120 g. At about 1.5 kcal/g, with some added fat, that comes to about 190 kcal.

The spinach salad with carrot and cucumber is perhaps 40 g and adds about 20–30 kcal, including a little dressing.

Total: about 160 g of food and about 215 kcal.
